notes: Orders from the seat can be answered with buttons on the counter's Telegram: Accept starts the customer's countdown, Ready tells them it is ready, Decline tells them it is cancelled and puts the stock back. Dropping a desktop shortcut on the Games page now fills in the program, its arguments and its Start in folder from the shortcut's Properties. The ledger records time bought and time left to the second. With security switched off, the operator panel opens without a password. The tray icon's right-click menu is down to Show RapTech - staff use the cog.
